precepts.text: Unto me the children of Israel are servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; I am the Most High your God.
precepts.point: These servants stand by night in the house of the Most High.

note.label: Psalm 134: The Servants Blessing the Most High in the Sanctuary

precepts.why: “Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord”. Not everyone is a servant. “For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.” The servants are the children of Israel, the so-called blacks, Spanish, and native Indians, and these are the servants who stand by night in the house of the Most High.

precepts.text: Yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
precepts.point: The Most High cast us off among the heathen and scattered us among the countries, yet he became to us a little sanctuary in the countries where we come. In these sanctuaries you learn who the ungodly are, who prosper in this world serving Satan, and what their end is.

note.label: Psalm 134: The Servants Blessing the Most High in the Sanctuary

precepts.why:
“Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.” The sanctuary is the house of the Most High where you go every Sabbath, the little sanctuaries IUIC has set up. “Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.”

The Most High cast us off among the heathen and scattered us among the countries, yet he became to us a little sanctuary in the countries where we come.

precepts.text: The ungodly prosper, but when I went into the sanctuary of God then understood I their end.
precepts.point: The Most High cast us off among the heathen and scattered us among the countries, yet he became to us a little sanctuary in the countries where we come. In these sanctuaries you learn who the ungodly are, who prosper in this world serving Satan, and what their end is.

note.label: Psalm 134: The Servants Blessing the Most High in the Sanctuary

precepts.why: “Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.” It was too painful to understand, “Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.” In the sanctuary, where we lift up our hands and bless the Most High, you learn who the ungodly are, who prosper in this world serving Satan, and what their end is.
